notes: Two starts, evidence even. (1) Devore Creek trail from Weaver Point (reached from Stehekin: bus to Harlequin Bridge, walk ~3.5 mi, or packraft to Weaver Point), then Bird Creek camp: countryhighpoints.com blog (opened) says this is the normal approach for Tupshin/Devore/Flora but it is a personal blog about the group of peaks, not route-specific, and it noted the Company Creek option was not mentioned; WTA 2007 report and CascadeClimbers 2007 report used Devore Creek (search snippets only, pages 403, weak). WTA hike page (opened) lists Weaver Point Campground as the start, but its printed coordinate 48.2971,-120.7504 equals the peak summit, so unusable as a trailhead placement. (2) Company Creek trail from Stehekin: lemkeclimbs.com 2018 report (opened) went up Company Creek trail, camped in basin SE of Tupshin, and descended Devore Creek trail; page says nothing about which is usual. Route's own text lists Company Creek first and says most parties July-Sept use Devore Creek to Bird Creek camp. No coordinate for Weaver Point/Company Creek TH from a land-manager page. SummitPost, CascadeClimbers, Mountaineers, WTA trip reports returned 403.
